question_images.description: Chemical structure of Product C, a bis-indole derivative. It consists of a 5-methoxy-3-(2-(alkylamino)ethyl)-1H-indol-2-yl group attached to the C3 position of a 3-(2-(alkylamino)ethyl)-indolin-2-one group. The C3 position of the oxindole is a quaternary stereocenter with a wedge bond to the indole and a dash bond to the -CH2CH2NHR group.
